integrity: The exact starting finite product and radial diagonalization are attributed to published primary sources. Infinite-product periodicity, uniform error and nonconstancy have complete analytic arguments; numerical tests are corroborative only. No independent audit has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the exact zeroth-Hermite Gaussian Rayleigh eigenvalue on mid-third Cantor annuli, not the full operator norm. It refines the known finite product by establishing a nonconstant logarithmically periodic leading factor and a uniform quantitative remainder in a double-scaling regime. Other eigenvalue modes, other Cantor alphabets and independent priority assessment are not claimed.
title: A nonconstant log-periodic Gaussian localization profile for Cantor annuli
